calls.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Solar Friends watering animation equipment layer, SECOND pose. Image 1 is the exact full-frame resident pose placement reference; never output or repaint that person. Image 2 is the watering-can design and previous full-frame equipment pose: preserve its SAME blue can, reservoir proportions, handle, long spout, rose nozzle, painted texture, highlights and physical size. On an identically framed 1254x1254 transparent square, repaint ONLY that can in the next pose: carry-handle grip should meet the near hand around (818,666); far hand at (975,705) supports the rim/upper side. Relative to image 2, the held can moves slightly right and down, and tips about five degrees clockwise to begin lowering its spout. Do not enlarge it, redesign it, center it or crop to it. Keep entire spout/rose inside the canvas with at least 20 pixels margin. Soft upper-left painted sunlight; no new patina or sharp specular glints. Exact same artist and visual weight as the blue can reference. True transparency including handle opening; output ONLY equipment, no hands, arms, skin, body, ground, shadow or water stream. Blank transparent space remains above/left. This is an authored pose in shared full-body coordinates, not an inventory icon.
calls.finding: Same can reads as the beginning of a tip, foreground hand contact reviewed.
